newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American amends Jockey Club offer.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American amends Jockey Club offer.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said Monday its takeover offer for California Jockey Club and Bay Meadows Operating Co had been amended, eliminating the offer of $33 cash per share.

Under the amended terms, cleared by the Securities and Exchange Commission, shareholders of California Jockey, for each of their shares, will receive 1.927 Patriot American shares as reconstituted following the merger.
California Jockey and Bay Meadows are real estate concerns whose shares are paired.

Patriot American said the structure of the merger was changed in light of its significant share price increase since the merger was announced last October. Patriot American shares closed Friday at 21-1/2.
With SEC clearance, Patriot American said, the amended agreement can now be presented for approval to the shareholders of both companies.
Both companies will convene meetings of their shareholders on July l to vote on the transaction, it said.
